name: @rozie-ui/select
comment:exports: vendorable: true (D-02). A vendorable primitive exposes its canonical .rozie source under a STABLE subpath so the D-07 <components> specifier `@rozie-ui/select/Select.rozie` resolves via ProducerResolver (enhanced-resolve, exportsFields:['exports']) for every NON-codegen consumer — the VR harness, the surface test, the IDE LSP, and any consumer that compiles the composite from raw source. Codegen itself never hits this path (it remaps the specifier to the local vendored sibling in-memory before compile); this export is the universal authoring/dev-time half of the same forward-to-Option-A contract.
comment:headless-core-devdep: Phase 64 (D-06 / P2): @rozie-ui/headless-core is a SOURCE-ONLY workspace package whose `listCore.rzts` script-partial DISSOLVES into this family's compiled leaves via inlineScriptPartials() at compile — zero runtime dependency. It is a devDependency (the cross-package bare-specifier import is resolved at compile-time via the producer exports map; the canonical add-as-devDep mechanism proven in 64-01, no tsconfig paths needed).
comment:virtual-core-dep: Phase 64 (P4 / SC-5): @tanstack/virtual-core is the framework-agnostic windowing state machine the shared windowing.rzts math drives (the data-table precedent — NO per-framework adapter). The compiled leaves import it at module top level, whether or not `virtual` is on, so it is a REQUIRED (non-optional) peerDependency of each leaf; here it is a devDependency so the source resolves for codegen + the VR build.
comment:popover-devdep: Select composes @rozie-ui/popover (Option A, the combobox/data-table precedent) to float its popup. The six `@rozie-ui/popover-<target>` packages are devDependencies so pnpm symlinks them into select/node_modules — the surface @rozie/core's resolveManifestProducer walks (node_modules UPWARD from select/src) to resolve the `<components>` specifier `@rozie-ui/popover/Popover.rozie` to the published per-target package's compiled manifest, for codegen, the surface gate, the VR build and the LSP. Each select leaf declares `@rozie-ui/popover-<target>` as a runtime peerDependency. The plain `@rozie-ui/popover` devDependency is kept alongside for the raw-.rozie authoring surface (mirrors combobox).
